visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair and glasses, wearing a light grey t-shirt, sits on a bed or soft mat. He holds a yellow plush dog toy and a patterned blanket. Two young girls with dark hair, one in a checkered top and the other in a striped tank top, face him from behind a safety rail or playpen edge. The room is indoors with warm, soft lighting, showing a shelf with tissue boxes and small stuffed animals in the background. (2) The man covers the plush dog with the blanket and manipulates it rhythmically. The children watch his hands and the blanket closely. Yellow text appears at the bottom. He then pulls the blanket away to reveal the toy has "reappeared," causing the girls to smile and lean forward. (3) The man repeats the trick, but this time the older girl in the striped shirt climbs over the curved nursing pillow to peek under the blanket. She discovers the hidden toy, pointing at the secret location. The setting remains stable with consistent warm indoor lighting. (4) The older girl takes the blanket and the plush toy, attempting to perform the same magic trick for her younger sister in the playpen. The man watches from the side, smiling. The girl uses exaggerated hand movements to wave the blanket over the pillow. (5) The girl successfully reveals the toy, and the younger sister in the playpen begins to clap enthusiastically. The man also claps his hands in encouragement. The camera maintains a medium shot of the family interaction. (6) The scene transitions to a pink graphic outro featuring a cartoon girl character and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE' centered on the screen.
